summary:
Research of w112 (model check's gaps: r27, r106, r111) is complete; notes in .shop/scratch/1-research/notes.md.
5 of 18 accepted scenarios are red, each by a missing step or a wrong assertion: no-job Given, green-retired Given, guarantees Given, FIELDS key 'accepts thing#r2 and no check', and a malformed-row branch.
Code behind them: scripts/model_work.py:184-192 (accepts fact and r27 problem only for scenario-named requirements), scripts/model.lp:276 (w_unserved_cap has no job condition).
Probes (run) confirm the defects: no-job warning printed, v_w4 for an unnamed accept, file problems for guarantees and green-retired accepts.
Old assumptions: work_items.py refuses a run whose accepted requirements have no scenario; supervise_brief and xfail handling also assume scenarios.
Tests broken by r111: tests/scripts/test_model_output.py test_check_ends_with_the_four_counts (asserts 1 warnings). The rest stay.
tests-of and untested had no map; their lists are by search. git status is clean; scratch is ignored.
